# charly pipeline — the generic agent/workflow engine

`charly pipeline` is the domain-neutral agent/workflow engine. Served by
`candy/plugin-pipeline` (`command:pipeline`, out-of-process over gRPC).

## What it provides

- the bare agent runtime (the plan agent stage + the standalone `charly pipeline agent`);
- the plan executor — `charly pipeline run <entity>`;
- deterministic probe verbs;
- template/frontmatter rendering;
- redo + fail-hard semantics;
- skills by `@github` candy refs.

Every pipeline is a DECLARED plan (`kind:pipeline` entity, SDD CUE-first), so the
engine is config-driven rather than code-driven.

## When to use it

To run or author a `kind:pipeline` entity, or to build an agent workflow that joins
the runtime through configuration (e.g. the `charly review --plan` executor).
